title: Starter snapshot: sequenced getting-started tiles for Hosted API
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a set of getting-started screenshot tiles that reveal the Hosted API flow in a sequenced manner: model selection, request builder with live param knobs, and three code snippet variants (curl, JavaScript SDK, Python). Focus on concise micro-tiles for docs and the Quickstart section, plus a modal series used in the in-product tour. Include mobile and desktop crops and keyboard-focus / high-contrast variants for accessibility. Deliverables should be export-ready PNGs + layered Figma file with annotations.
acceptance_criteria: All 10 PNG tiles exported at 2x and 3x with correct artboards
Code snippet tiles contain copyable code blocks and match SDK docs
Model picker shows curated example model and tooltip explaining tradeoffs
Request builder tile demonstrates temperature, max_tokens, and streaming toggle
Mobile crops preserve key affordances and CTA tap targets
High-contrast variants meet WCAG AA color contrast for text
Design review signoff from PM and Docs obtained
Figma file has layer naming and export tags for engineering handoff
comments: 2026-03-02 Maya Chen: Initial wireframes uploaded to Figma. Focus on progressive reveal rather than showing full config immediately.
2026-03-04 Carlos Rivera: Prototype for request builder live preview ready; needs copy changes for streaming toggle.

2026-03-08 Eng feedback (Grant): Ensure snippet images show headers with exact curl flags we ship; requested adding a one-line network note.
2026-03-09 Accessibility check (Lena): Contrast on the model tags fails AA at small sizes; created high-contrast alternate tile.

qa_notes: Test tile assets in Chrome and Safari at 100% and 200% zoom. Verify code text is selectable in docs generator and that image alt text is provided in asset manifest.
handoff_instructions: Zip contains PNGs and SVGs; include README that maps filenames to docs sections and lists suggested alt text. Attach the PR URL for docs update. Mark final assets with suffix _FINAL.
notes: Trade-offs: kept request builder UI minimal to avoid scaring new users; complex options hidden under 'advanced' to keep tiles readable. If PM wants more depth, produce an expanded set for the developer center. Next steps: resolve copy edits, finalize exports, tag assets for release pipeline.
